name: uno-royale-android
description: UNO Royale: 2-Player Duels - Native Android Kotlin & Jetpack Compose Game

scripts.dev: node -e 'const { spawn } = require("child_process"); spawn("node", ["backend/dist/index.js"], { stdio: "inherit" }); function startTunnel() { const t = spawn("npx", ["--yes", "localtunnel", "--port", "3000", "--subdomain", "unoroyale-duel"], { stdio: "inherit" }); t.on("close", () => setTimeout(startTunnel, 3000)); } startTunnel();'
